text: Chivas Regal, the Scotch whisky on the Ferrari partner grid, is produced by Chivas Brothers, a subsidiary of the listed French spirits group Pernod Ricard (Euronext Paris: RI).
short: Chivas Regal is produced by Chivas Brothers, a subsidiary of Pernod Ricard.
